messages:
Sara Venkatar: Quick thread 0: draft RN is up. Need a 2-sentence internal blurb + explicit canary rollback conditions. Who can take?
Drew Patel: I can draft the blurb. Ask: do we want to call out the pinned model version and the fallback variant in the blurb?
Sara Venkatar: Yes please. Pin rwd-7b-v1 for 24h, fallback to rwd-7b-q2 for degraded latency. Mention it explicitly.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: staging -> canary at 09:45 PDT (build 2026.03.28-88).
Omar Nguyen: For rollback gates, recommend two signals: (1) 95p latency > 1.2s for 10m, OR (2) error-rate jump > 1% absolute for 5m. If either, ops should start rollback.
Lena Park: +1. Also include a soft-signal: if user-facing hallucation reports (CS) > 3 tickets in 30m, escalate.
Drew Patel: Draft internal blurb: "Were deploying a performance/stability update to our hosted model. Pinned to rwd-7b-v1 (24h); fallback rwd-7b-q2. Expect lower P95 under load. If you own prompt templates or business logic, please validate your evals during the canary." Thoughts?
Sara Venkatar: Nice. Trim second sentence: "Pinned to rwd-7b-v1 for 24h; fallback rwd-7b-q2 on latency regressions." Keep it concise.
ci-cd-bot: canary kickoff: healthchecks running (latency, accuracy-sanity, logs).
Omar Nguyen: Adding rollback play in RN doc: steps + commands. Example: `ci-cd rollback --target rwd-7b-q2 --reason "canary latency" --tag 2026.03.28-88`
Drew Patel: I'll add a one-line instruction for on-call: "If alerted, notify #eng-oncall and @release-lead, then follow the rollback playbook."
Sara Venkatar: Assignments: Drew = post internal blurb at +20m, Omar = populate RN with rollback commands and thresholds, Lena = put CS watch on the RN and add Slack escalation, ops = standby for manual rollback.
deploy-bot: canary status: 30m elapsed, checks passing.
Lena Park: I linked the CS form + dashboard in the RN: https://redwood.internal/rn/2026-03-28-rwd-7b-update. Also set a PagerDuty rule for CS spikes.
Drew Patel: Posting internal blurb now to staff email draft. Will ping when sent.
Sara Venkatar: Thank you everyone. If anything trips the gates, call an immediate freeze here and well run rollback. :rotating_light:
